author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override kd22 k50 δ0.10 emb_k=17 γ_max=0.70 (DAQB)
abstract: Same as above but with δ=0.10; γ_max=0.70 to improve Cell_cycle/biology, aiming to reach ≥0.744 while maintaining PCR≈1.0 and cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
